property_summary: For every input, calling transfer(...) on the reference C reverts (does not return true) when contract_address == address(0), but the mutant that allows address(0) can complete and return true for some inputs — therefore the reference must never return true for contract_address == address(0), while the mutant may.
change_summary: Relax validAddress to allow the zero address, changing which calls pass the modifier and thus affect return behavior.
